syncSegmentsEn.text: Eden’s beauty is long gone, never to return
A wounded white dove can scarcely spread its wings and soar
The garden flowers have long since withered
When will the weeping soul find comfort?
Atop Golgotha, the innocent Lamb bore our sins in our place
Eternal redemption was accomplished, a work of wonder and majesty
The darkened earth sees the light of dawn again
The weary soul at last receives grace again
Turn your heart back and let your spirit soar
Jesus loves you. He is waiting for you
He is the one true treasure of your life
